g.text: r · Reuse saved research or research this repo; clones automatically.
Shift+R · Generate fresh research and fill missing card fields.
v · Switch between Host brief and Research card using saved results.
n · Save your own notes independently of generated research.
t · Presets, sections, preview and saved defaults.
h · Sources, provider, commit and changes since the previous report.
e · Edit your presentation overrides and notes together.
x · Export the selected card or marked repositories to Markdown.
